title: Image channel ledger (one per project)
description: Append-only ledger, one file per project, not one file per image. Entries are references to images stored once in the project's own asset folders.

log_path.description: Where this ledger lives, relative to the project root. Defaults to workflow/image_channel_log.json unless the project entry file declares otherwise.

asset_root.description: Declared asset folder for this project, if it differs from the standard layout. The rule never hard-codes this.
